_note: The child's two scenes (Child, data/child.json; docs/DESIGN.md, ความรักและแต่งงาน -> ลูก). <spouse>_news: the spouse tells the farmer in the farmhouse one morning (data/events/child_news_<spouse>.json). The birth (data/events/child_birth_<spouse>.json): birth (Tome and Dr. Yae, the same for every spouse), then <spouse>_names, where the spouse offers their three names from data/child.json (<spouse>_pick: the choice sets child_name; the event's child step stores it), the spouse's answer to the name picked (<spouse>_<name>), and born (Tome). No gender for the child: the name, they, the little one. Our own lines.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: There you are, dear. Yae came at first light, and it's all done. Everyone is well.

lines.speaker: yae
lines.text: Healthy, loud and hungry. The best kind of patient. No fee for this one.

lines.speaker: tome
lines.text: Welcome to the valley, little one. Now rest, all of you. The farm can wait one morning.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Sit down a moment. No, really, sit. I've done the sums three times and they come out the same.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: There's going to be one more of us. Yae says by next season. A new name for the ledger.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: One more of us... That's wonderful.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Don't cry on the rice. And don't tell Kota yet, or the whole valley knows by noon.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Look at those fists, holding on already. Father would say that's a born shopkeeper.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: I've had three names in the back of the ledger for weeks. You choose.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Hinata. A sunny spot. Every store needs one by the window.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Sora. The whole sky. Big enough for both our books.

lines.speaker: sayo
lines.text: Aoi. Like the hollyhocks by the store. Tall and stubborn. Good.

lines.speaker: fumi
lines.text: Sit with me before the tea. I want to say this while it's still only ours.

lines.speaker: fumi
lines.text: We'll need another cup at the kotatsu. A very small one. Yae says by next season.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Another cup... Fumi, that's wonderful.

lines.speaker: fumi
lines.text: Mother used to say a house fills up one cup at a time. I think Mother would be laughing now.

lines.speaker: fumi
lines.text: So small. Mother's kettle is bigger. ...Don't tell anyone I cried into the tea towel.

lines.speaker: fumi
lines.text: I have three names, folded up in the tea tin. You pick. I'll love whichever you say.

lines.speaker: fumi
lines.text: Nagisa. The shore where the water is calm. Yes. That's how I want our house to be.

lines.speaker: fumi
lines.text: Makoto. Sincere. Like a good cup of tea, with nothing hidden in it.

lines.speaker: fumi
lines.text: Akira. Bright and clear. The first light through the teahouse shutters.

lines.speaker: haru
lines.text: Wait. Before the field. I... I made something. It's too small for you.

lines.speaker: haru
lines.text: Little sandals. Yae says we'll need them by next season. ...Do you see what I mean?

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Haru... you mean...?

lines.speaker: haru
lines.text: Mm. Don't shout. You can wave at the hill later, as hard as you like.

lines.speaker: haru
lines.text: They fit in one arm. I thought I'd be scared. I'm not.

lines.speaker: haru
lines.text: I thought of three names, up at the lookout. Say one. Whichever sounds right to you.

lines.speaker: haru
lines.text: Kaoru. Like the straw when it's drying. A good smell. A home smell.

lines.speaker: haru
lines.text: Hikaru. The light on the paddies in the morning. ...It suits them.

lines.speaker: haru
lines.text: Yuki. Quiet, like the first snow on the hill. I like quiet.

lines.speaker: ichiro
lines.text: Sit. Got something to say. Not good at this.

lines.speaker: ichiro
lines.text: Yae came by. We'll be three. Next season.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Three of us... Ichiro, really?

lines.speaker: ichiro
lines.text: Really. I'll build a cradle. Cedar, not oak. Oak's too hard for a baby.

lines.speaker: ichiro
lines.text: So small. I've held hot coals in these hands. This is harder.

lines.speaker: ichiro
lines.text: Three names. Thought them over at the kiln. You choose.

lines.speaker: ichiro
lines.text: Minato. A harbor. Somewhere to come home to. Good.

lines.speaker: ichiro
lines.text: Asahi. Morning sun. Came at first light. Fits.

lines.speaker: ichiro
lines.text: Tsubasa. Wings. They'll go farther than the woods. That's fine.

lines.speaker: mio
lines.text: Don't go out yet! Sit, sit. I've got news, and it's bigger than any fish.

lines.speaker: mio
lines.text: We're going to be three! Yae says by next season. I asked twice.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Three of us? Mio, that's wonderful!

lines.speaker: mio
lines.text: Father's boat will have a new passenger. I'll teach them to pole before they can walk!

lines.speaker: mio
lines.text: Look at that grip! Born for a pole and a net, this one.

lines.speaker: mio
lines.text: I've got three names. I said them all to the river and it didn't complain. You pick!

lines.speaker: mio
lines.text: Mizuki! The moon on the water, like the nights by the ferry. Perfect.

lines.speaker: mio
lines.text: Izumi. A spring, where the river starts. Where we start.

lines.speaker: mio
lines.text: Kai! The sea. Short and loud, just like that cry.

lines.speaker: kaede
lines.text: I drew a fortune this morning. Great blessing, again. But this time I know why.

lines.speaker: kaede
lines.text: We're going to be three. Yae says by next season. The fox statues knew before you did.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Three...? Kaede, really?

lines.speaker: kaede
lines.text: Really! I'll tie a charm for an easy birth at the shrine today. Two, to be safe.

lines.speaker: kaede
lines.text: Tiny! And so loud. The gods must have heard that all the way up the steps.

lines.speaker: kaede
lines.text: I have three names. I asked the shrine about each one. All great blessings. You choose.

lines.speaker: kaede
lines.text: Rin. Like the bell at the shrine, clear and small. It suits them.

lines.speaker: kaede
lines.text: Michi. A path. Tome showed me mine. Now we'll show them theirs.

lines.speaker: kaede
lines.text: Tomo. A friend. And the first friends they'll have are us.

lines.speaker: shino
lines.text: Sit. I'll say it plainly. That's how I say things.

lines.speaker: shino
lines.text: We'll be three. Yae says by next season. I've started on a small length of indigo.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Three of us... Shino, that's wonderful.

lines.speaker: shino
lines.text: It is. Don't fuss. ...Well. Fuss a little.

lines.speaker: shino
lines.text: Look. Their hands aren't blue. Give them time.

lines.speaker: shino
lines.text: Three names. I've kept them a while. You choose. Any of them is good.

lines.speaker: shino
lines.text: Natsu. Summer, when the vats run deepest. Good.

lines.speaker: shino
lines.text: Shun. The best time for a thing. This was ours.

lines.speaker: shino
lines.text: Chihiro. A thousand fathoms. Deep, like the darkest dip.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: Hold on, before the round. For once I'm the one with news to deliver.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: We're going to be three! Yae says by next season. I've known a whole day and told nobody.

lines.speaker: farmer
lines.text: Three of us? Ren, that's wonderful!

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: Best news I've ever carried, and it's for us. I'll keep it quiet. ...Mostly.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: Look at them! Ten fingers, ten toes. I counted. Twice.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: I've got three names. Tried them out on every mailbox in the valley. You pick.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: Riku. Land. Somewhere to stand. Every road ends on it.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: Hotaru. A firefly. Small and bright, out by the pond on summer nights.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: Kou. Short. Easy to call across the yard. I'm a practical sort.
